verdict: Yes, for a practical founder. Peeschute from Jalna pitched a portable, disposable urine bag on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Travellers, patients and elderly people need hygienic options where toilets are unavailable, and the product is cheap to make.
angle: Long road trips, traffic jams, hospitals and events create real demand for portable urination products. Pharmacies, travel stores and online channels work well. Clear instructions and discreet packaging help buyers try the product.
